steps.title: Analyze Requirements
steps.description: Evaluate requirements for a modern, flat dark theme calculator with smooth visual click states.

steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Establish standard app configuration mapping to com.moderncalculator.app.

steps.title: Configure Multi-Project Setup
steps.description: Create settings.gradle for clean multi-project builds with appropriate repository configurations.

steps.title: Configure Root Build Script
steps.description: Set up root build.gradle to load Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure Application Build Script
steps.description: Create app/build.gradle defining target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and compile rules under Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Design Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml defining the package, launch activity, portrait orientation, and theme.

steps.title: Establish Dark Palette Resources
steps.description: Define beautiful color constants for dark gray layout backgrounds, crisp text, and vibrant button shades inside colors.xml.

steps.title: Create Numeric Button Background Selector
steps.description: Develop button_number_bg.xml to handle rounded rect buttons and active pressed tinting.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Background Selector
steps.description: Develop button_operator_bg.xml to manage styling and touch feedback for mathematical operator keys.

steps.title: Create Utility Button Background Selector
steps.description: Create button_clear_bg.xml to style custom key buttons such as Clear, Delete and Percentage.

steps.title: Create Equal Button Background Selector
steps.description: Construct button_equal_bg.xml with an active state selector to make the core computation button stand out.

steps.title: Implement Elegant Keypad Layout
steps.description: Build modern responsive grid utilizing nested weights in activity_main.xml to guarantee precise sizing on all device dimensions.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Logic Engine
steps.description: Program standard decimal calculation logic inside MainActivity.java supporting addition, subtraction, division, multiplication, percentages, and floating points.

steps.title: Verify State and Event Wiring
steps.description: Bind all buttons dynamically and write standard onClick standard interfaces matching Java 8 standards.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug build processes to compile resource bundles and package final binaries.
